title: Dispatch: repair Sol S1 (citation population) and S2 (real vitest membership) in candidate gates (attempt 1)
description:
Repair the two MATERIAL findings from Sol's final review of PR #697. Read them in full with `bd show eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3.2`. The base is branch eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 at b47b0ca4. The files are packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/candidateGates.ts, cli.ts and packages/core/test/dnd5eSrdAuditBundleGates.test.ts.

S1, the citation population. G-finding-evidence must not silently drop any file-shaped citation in a statusReasoning.
- Extract every token that looks like a repository file. That means a path or basename ending in a file extension such as .ts, .mjs, .js, .json or .md, with optional leading directories.
- Resolve each token deterministically against the git-tracked file list. Inject the list for tests; in the CLI, get it from `git ls-files`.
  (a) A root-anchored path resolves as is.
  (b) A `test/...` token resolves under packages/core/.
  (c) Any other token resolves to the unique tracked file whose path ends with `/<token>`.
  (d) A basename that names a committed pack artifact (VERIFIED_PACK_ARTIFACTS, plus manifest.json when the reasoning says pack or records) resolves to packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/<name>. Apply this as the explicit rule for ambiguous pack-artifact basenames, and say so in observes.
  (e) A token that is unresolved (0 matches) or still ambiguous (more than 1 match) is a FAILURE, never a silent drop.
- Rows whose reasoning has no file-shaped token stay 'no committed evidence pointer'; that is not a failure.
- The denominator is the distinct resolved citations plus the unresolved ones.
- Remove the doesNotObserve line that excused shorthand citations.
- Run the gate against the real committed registry and report the result. If a real citation in the committed registry is unresolved or ambiguous, do NOT edit the registry: another PR, #698, owns it. Report the citation and stop before committing so the supervisor can decide.

S2, actual test membership. Replace the regex parse of vitest.config.ts with the real resolved membership.
- The bundle captures `npx vitest list --filesOnly --json` from the repo root. It is supported on the installed vitest 5.0.5 and returns absolute file paths evaluated with the real include and exclude.
- Normalize the paths to repo-relative, and use that set as membership for G-finding-evidence, G-capabilities and G-replay.
- If the command fails, or its output does not parse or is empty, every gate that depends on membership is failed-to-run.
- Delete the regex config parser and its tests. Replace them with tests that inject membership:
  - an evidence test absent from the membership set fails (the narrowing and exclude controls Sol describes);
  - unavailable membership gives failed-to-run.

Tests:
- One generalized citation-resolution test covering forms (a) to (e), each with an injected missing-path control.
- The membership tests above.
- Never weaken the existing tests.

Finish:
- Run `npm run verify:worktree` before committing, and commit only if it exits 0.
- The message starts with `eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3.3 ` and ends with the line `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Record the report with `bd update eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3.3 --append-notes`, then run `bd close eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3.3`.
- Do not push, open a PR or merge.
